summary: Jiayin Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K on July 23, 2026, reporting the resignation of Director Xiaojing Lu and Chief Risk Officer Dan Qi, both effective July 20, 2026. Lu also left the compensation and nominating/corporate governance committees; Qi vacated her executive role. Neither departure resulted from any disagreement with the Company. The Board will not immediately fill the board vacancy and will fill each role upon identifying suitable candidates. No terms, prices, or advisors are stated. This is a non-US foreign private issuer report equivalent to a current report on Form 8-K. Watch for any further management or strategic changes as the Company fills these roles.
